about: Measured by StructuresParityTest on the real game (ADR 0122 D9, B639): what each target's server made of the files of fixtures/structures-parity. assembly: per structure, the starts Structure.generate made for world seeds 634 and 635 at chunks 0 to grid - 1 on both axes, as a chunk's structure step makes them; README.md lists every field. processors: per processor list, the sample placed 32 times by the start's own placeInChunk, each cell read back in the template's frame. Rewritten by the parity build's structuresParity task with -PupdateStructuresParity; never edited by hand.
